evaluation.overall_comment: The translation successfully conveys the core scientific content and maintains the conversational podcast structure. While comprehensible to a knowledgeable reader, the linguistic inconsistencies and grammatical awkwardness detract significantly from its overall quality. It requires professional editing to meet publication standards, particularly in fluency, terminology standardization, and contextual localization of broadcast phrases.
